Power Seminars

Revolutionizing Power Conversion for a Sustainable Future
April 16 - 25
Staying up to date on the latest advancements in power supply design is one of the many challenges engineers face today. To help designers meet this challenge, we are pleased to host the
2024 Power Seminars
sponsored by Würth Elektronik.
Learn Real-World Application Examples
Our power experts will provide rich technical and practical presentations that combine new, advanced power supply concepts, tutorial review of fundamental design principles and application examples.
What Should You Expect?
Attendees will receive in-depth theoretical and practical discussions on each topic and pros and cons of different solutions to improve energy efficiency and system performance.
Topics
Our team of experts is travelling to 6 locations and will cover 6 topics that directly relate to many power engineers’ design needs.
